record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: GALARIAN_YAMASK (1 star) and RUNERIGUS (2 stars) declare GRUDGE (maxPP 95, range 2, passive NONE). Shared strategy; the difference is the star index and stats. GRUDGE_DIVE is a different strategy and is not covered.
record.summary: Requests a 3000 ms silence on the cast target, then deals SPECIAL damage (18/36/52/104 raw by stars) to EVERY entity of another team on the board whose status is silenced at that moment, not only to the cast target. The filter runs after the silence request, so the cast target is hit only if the request succeeded or it was already silenced (a runeProtect or tree target is not silenced by this cast and is hit only if already silenced by something else); enemies silenced earlier by any source are hit too. The silenced state also stops those units from casting (canCast) and from gaining positive PP.

targeting.who: silence: the cast target. damage: all entities on the board with another team than the caster's and status.silence true after the silence request
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; target selection before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: no geometry: board-wide filter on the silence status (range only limits where the caster can stand to cast the ability at its target, range 2)

effects.scaling: requested amount per silenced enemy = raw x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); multiplied by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); the same crit flag applies to every hit; AP does not scale the silence duration
effects.resolution: requested -> applied: each hit goes through handleSpecialDamage and handleDamage separately (SPE_DEF division with ceil and minimum 1 per enemy); the applied loss (takenDamage) is discarded by the strategy. Protect / skydiving / magicBounce targets take none (magicBounce queues a delayed bounce on the caster unless Protective Pads); a dead or resurrecting target takes none. Shield, Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band branches are as for any special damage (see the BITE record). A silenced enemy is not damaged more by the ability itself; one separate unit passive (HISUIAN_TYPHLOSION attackers, x1.2 against burning or silenced targets) exists in handleDamage but neither listed unit has it.

statusEffects.applicationOrder: before the damage filter (so the target's own silence counts)
statusEffects.guards: not applied if the target's status has runeProtect or tree; MURKY weather multiplies the duration by 1.3; the duration then passes through applyStatusDurationReductions on the target (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7 / HYDRATION x0.5 / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3, Odd Keystone); the silence flag becomes true whenever the guards pass, and a longer duration replaces silenceCooldown and sets silenceOrigin to the caster; a shorter or equal one leaves the cooldown and origin.
statusEffects.combatEffect: a silenced unit cannot cast (canCast false) and does not gain positive PP (addPP ignores positive values while silenced); the status ends when silenceCooldown runs out. The SYNCHRO passive of another unit can re-silence silenceOrigin; not part of this cast.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; 3-star (52), 4-star (104) and the fallback are not reachable by the two listed units' bare star counts. Silence duration is 3000 for every star level.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target within range 2 to cast. The damage set is independent of position.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast re-requests the silence (extending only if longer) and damages all currently silenced enemies again, so enemies silenced by earlier casts or by other units are hit again on every cast while their silence lasts.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 18 (Galarian Yamask) / 36 (Runerigus) per silenced enemy, silence 3000 ms. Requested damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then the SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and untraced modifiers; the applied loss is discarded by the strategy. Silence: requested 3000 ms, applied after MURKY and status reductions, and only if the target has no runeProtect / tree.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers) - the SPECIAL speDef division was read, no probe was run
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence of the caster) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
applyStatusDurationReductions inputs (Odd Keystone count) of the target's player
unresolved: Whether board.cells can still hold a dead entity at the moment of the filter (hp <= 0 but not yet removed) was not traced; handleDamage ignores such a unit
Which other abilities, items or passives apply silence to enemies (and so widen the damage set) was not enumerated; the filter accepts any source
MURKY weather and the tree status were read only in triggerSilence's guard
Neither unit has a passive in the catalog; no other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue
